description: Build shadow_mcp_indicators.py per Appendix B of the spec. Pure library module — no daemons, no network, no DB writes, no imports of protected modules. Exports URL-path and hostname-pattern detection functions for log analysis. Must: (1) include Cloudflare attribution docstring, (2) export is_shadow_mcp_host, detect_shadow_mcp_url_path pure functions, (3) compile regex patterns at module load, (4) include if __name__ == '__main__' self-smoke with at least three known-good inputs asserting non-empty results. Reference: Cloudflare enterprise MCP reference architecture, blog.cloudflare.com, 2026-04-14.
